calibration: Optical character height target is 56 world px, using the full alpha>=128 figure bbox (displaySize = 56 * canvas height / bbox height). Feet origin x is alpha-weighted centroid over the bottom 50 pixels of the alpha>=128 bbox; y is its exclusive bottom row normalized by canvas height. PNG source copied byte-for-byte from selected candidate. WebP runtime saved lossless with exact RGBA pixel equality; verified by full decoded RGBA byte comparison. No crop, flip, cleanup or resampling.
